nora: onboarding Orpheus-Lite (9B) today. quick smoke shows tokenizer contains a sentinel id 60000 that decodes to a private-use glyph (\\uE100). looks like vendor left a placeholder in the vocab. anyone seen 60000 before? :grimacing:

alex: never that exact id. can you paste a tiny encode/decode? also drop a small slice of vocab ordering if possible.

nora: repro snippet: 
```
>>> tok.encode("Start  end")
[101, 60000, 17, 2]
>>> tok.decode([101, 60000, 17, 2])
"Start \uE100 end"
```
Looks like tokens after 60000 are offset when compared to our embedding indices.

tomas: two quick flags: 1) sentinel > typical vocab_size may indicate exported padding of internal table; 2) vendor metadata lists rotary_base=16384 (we expect 8192). that frequency doubling will change rotary phase by head position and can show up as ranking/regression rather than catastrophic failure.

yu: I ran a lightweight AWQ-int4 conversion on the raw checkpoint:
- SummEval ROUGE-L: -1.9% vs fp16 baseline
- TriviaQA EM: -0.6%
- C4 perplexity: +0.4
So generation drop present but milder than some other cases.

eval-bot: staging note: {model: "orpheus-lite-awq-int4", summ_eval_rouge_l: "-1.9%", trivia_em: "-0.6%", tokens: "80k"}

nora: quick mitigation plan I propose: 1) alias 60000 -> existing PAD id (usually 0) at tokenization time 2) add a sparse embedding copy for safety so we don't shift full table 3) normalize rotary inv_freq to runtime base (scale by 8192/16384 = 0.5) and recompute sin/cos caches if present.

alex: alias approach looks good. for sparse copy, prefer explicit conditional copy only when sentinel id < checkpoint_vocab_size to avoid index errors. pseudocode: 
```python
alias = {60000: 0}
def remap(xs):
    return [alias.get(x, x) for x in xs]
# sparse embedding copy
if 60000 < ckpt_vocab_size:
    emb[0] = emb[60000]
```

tomas: rotary patch I used locally: 
```python
rotary_base = model.config.get('rotary_base', 8192)
if rotary_base != 8192:
    scale = 8192.0 / float(rotary_base)
    model.rotary.inv_freq *= scale
    if hasattr(model.rotary, 'precomputed'):
        model.rotary.recompute_caches()
```
I checked a handful of heads and positions: max attention logit diff vs fp16 < 5e-5 after scaling.

yu: I'm going to wire alias + sparse-copy + rotary-rescale into a temporary conversion hook and rerun AWQ pipeline tonight with the targeted summarization slice. I'll also add a small unit test that enforces encode->remap->embed->decode roundtrip equality for randomized short strings.

eval-bot: queued long-run: orpheus-lite conversion + eval on staging at 04:00 UTC, est duration 6h. branch: feat/orpheus-sentinel-fix.

deploy-bot: note: please attach id_alias.json to converted model if aliasing is applied, and emit a conversion metadata log (src_vocab_size, dst_vocab_size, aliases_applied).

nora: good call. adding conversion-metadata to the checklist and adding a follow-up ticket to add a conversion unit test in model-convert. thanks all :heart:

alex: small extra: add assert max(token_ids) < vocab_size to conversion tests so these sentinel cases don't slip by silently.

tomas: +1. will add a quick CI test snippet.

nora: pinging this thread when overnight results land. peace :v:
